title: Business Central v29: Use System Audit Fields in Analysis Mode and Profiles
summary: Business Central v29 enables administrators to use system audit fields (such as who created a record and when it was modified) directly in Analysis Mode and Profile customizations without building custom extensions. This configuration-driven approach reduces development effort and maintenance costs while improving audit visibility.
key_points: System audit fields like System Created At, System Created By, System Modified At, and System Modified By are now accessible in Analysis Mode and Profiles
Previously, these fields required custom page extensions to display, introducing development and maintenance overhead
Administrators can now configure audit information visibility for specific user roles through Profiles without code
Analysis Mode users can explore and analyze records by creator, review modifications, track ownership trends, and improve troubleshooting
This enhancement reduces customization footprint, accelerates deployments, and improves supportability for audit investigations
features: System Audit Fields in Analysis Mode
